Accessibility of patches over the network (A)

Source: R/fn_network.R
accessibility.Rd

Finds the travel time from the origin (field office / trailhead) to each patch: drive the roads, walk the trails, then an off-trail Tobler hop to the centroid. Each patch is joined to its k nearest origin-reachable nodes and takes the cheapest total route, so a patch beside an isolated trail fragment bushwhacks to the usable network (a finite cost) instead of coming back NA, and can enter via a connected trail it passes rather than a dead-end stub. Returns the patches with a rescaled score and the augmented graph (with patches as nodes), so complementarity runs on the same structure.

Usage

accessibility(
  lines,
  patches,
  dem = NULL,
  origins = NULL,
  k = 3,
  road_speed = 30,
  trail_speed = 4,
  snap = 1,
  connect = 50,
  speeds = osm_speeds,
  offtrail_speed = 5,
  offtrail_penalty = 0.5,
  invert = TRUE
)

Arguments

lines

road/trail sf lines (see build_network).

patches

sf points or polygons; polygons are reduced to centroids.

dem

optional elevation SpatRaster (same CRS) for the Tobler hop slope; without it the hop uses offtrail_speed on the flat.

origins

trip start as sf point(s) — typically the field office, snapped free to the nearest road, after which road driving accrues time (often the dominant cost). NULL (default) treats every road node as a zero-cost origin ("distance from the road network", ignoring the drive).

k

nearest origin-reachable nodes each patch may enter through (default 3); the route uses whichever minimises drive/walk + hop.

road_speed, trail_speed, snap, connect, speeds

passed to build_network (speeds is the per-highway km/h lookup, default osm_speeds; connect bridges trailhead gaps).

offtrail_speed

unpenalised flat-ground off-trail speed in km/h when dem is absent (default 5, ~Tobler on the level).

offtrail_penalty

multiplier on the off-trail hop speed (default 0.5): cross-country through brush/talus is slower than the slope-only Tobler ideal, so this keeps trails faster than bushwhacking. 1 removes the penalty.

invert

if TRUE (default), the returned A is \(1 - \tilde t\) (accessible = high), the index form; raw hours are kept in access_hr.

Value

a list: patches (input patches + access_hr and A), net (the augmented build_network list), and patch_nodes (the patch vertex names) for reuse by complementarity.
